claude_take: The split today is between the protections being actively won and the ones quietly lapsing. SAG-AFTRA's animators secured real, enforceable limits on AI voices because actors still have a union to fight with, while nobody comparable is pushing back as OpenAI and ElevenLabs wire payment agents and new 'interaction engines' deeper into everyday apps. Meanwhile two older, unglamorous safeguards just failed on their own terms: Italy had to fine Meta nearly $900 million before it would stop defaulting into people's photo galleries, and the US let a 26-year public-health milestone lapse because enough people opted out of a vaccine. Even Balenciaga's leadership churn fits the pattern - it is far easier to install a new creative director than to rebuild whatever confidence keeps a house, a platform, or a public-health program standing in the first place.
claude_take_title: Some Guardrails Are Won, Others Just Lapse

items.headline: OpenAI Launches 'Businesses in ChatGPT,' Letting Companies Deploy Agents Inside the App
items.summary: OpenAI began rolling out 'Businesses in ChatGPT' in beta, letting companies claim verified profiles and build AI agents that answer customer questions and surface products directly inside conversations. The agent feature is initially limited to eligible US businesses, while the profile hub is open more broadly, and both are free at launch. The move follows a September test of sponsored business conversations and pushes ChatGPT further into ecommerce and local-business discovery, directly challenging tools like Google Business Profile.

items.headline: ElevenLabs Unveils an 'Interaction Engine' and a Workplace AI App at Its New York Summit
items.summary: At its New York summit, ElevenLabs previewed an 'Interaction Engine' that manages turn-taking and interruptions in voice-agent conversations, routing simple requests to cheaper models and harder ones to frontier models. It also opened early access to ElevenAI, a workplace app that turns conversations into notes and action items, launched a fine-tuning service letting businesses tune voice and open-source models on their own deployment data, and introduced a new partner marketplace.

items.headline: Johnny Depp's 'Ebenezer' Tops a Soft Box Office With His First Opening Win in Years
items.summary: Paramount's Ti West-directed 'Ebenezer,' starring Johnny Depp as a reimagined Scrooge, opened to roughly $19 million domestically and about $42 million worldwide over the weekend, below studio forecasts but enough to win a soft weekend and mark Depp's first box-office number one in years. Amazon MGM's star-driven heist comedy 'How to Rob a Bank' fared far worse, debuting at just $5 million.

items.headline: SAG-AFTRA Members Ratify New Animation Contracts With Updated AI Protections for Voice Actors
items.summary: SAG-AFTRA members voted to ratify new Television Animation and Basic Cable Animation agreements, running through mid-2030, extending the AI safeguards won in this year's live-action contract to animated and voice performance work. The deal also includes a wage increase for voice performers, giving the union another concrete, enforceable win in its multi-year push to contain AI's reach into performance.

items.headline: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Facebook's Secret Access to Users' Phone Photos
items.summary: Italy's data-protection authority fined Meta roughly €805 million (about $887 million) over a Facebook Android feature that scanned about 20 million Italian users' phone photo galleries by default without specific consent, violating the country's privacy rules. Meta has 60 days to add explicit opt-in consent and says it will appeal the fine as disproportionate.

items.headline: The US Loses Its Measles Elimination Status After 26 Years
items.summary: A Pan American Health Organization commission concluded that measles has now circulated continuously in the US for more than a year, ending the elimination status the country held since 2000, driven largely by a sustained outbreak in Utah. US cases topped 5,400 this year, the highest since 1991, and regaining the status will require at least 12 consecutive outbreak-free months.

items.headline: Martine Rose Officially Takes Over as Balenciaga's Creative Director
items.summary: Martine Rose's tenure at Balenciaga formally began, making her the house's first woman creative director, overseeing menswear, womenswear and couture. She succeeds Pierpaolo Piccioli, who exited after just 16 months in the third Kering creative-director shake-up in a month, and previously spent three years working under Demna at Balenciaga before launching her own London label; her first runway show for the house is not expected until March 2027.

items.headline: Wittgenstein's Language Games
items.headline_fr: Les jeux de langage de Wittgenstein
items.summary: In his later work, Ludwig Wittgenstein argued that words get their meaning not from fixed definitions or from pointing at things in the world, but from the varied, rule-governed activities, or 'language games,' in which we use them: giving orders, telling jokes, making promises, each with its own logic. Meaning, on this view, is use within a shared practice, not a private mental picture behind the word. The idea remains a cornerstone of philosophy of language and continues to inform debates about AI, since it raises the question of whether a system that only manipulates words, without sharing in human forms of life, can be said to mean anything at all.
items.summary_fr: Dans ses derniers travaux, Ludwig Wittgenstein soutient que les mots ne tirent pas leur sens de définitions fixes ni d'une correspondance avec les choses du monde, mais des activités variées et réglées, les « jeux de langage », dans lesquelles nous les employons : donner un ordre, raconter une blague, faire une promesse, chacune ayant sa propre logique. Le sens, dans cette perspective, c'est l'usage au sein d'une pratique partagée, non une image mentale privée derrière le mot. Cette idée reste un pilier de la philosophie du langage et nourrit aujourd'hui les débats sur l'intelligence artificielle, en posant la question de savoir si un système qui ne fait que manipuler des mots, sans partager les « formes de vie » humaines, peut vraiment être dit signifier quoi que ce soit.
